name: django-markdown-model
description: Small Django package that provides a custom Markdown field and an abstract model for Markdown-backed content stored in the database.
agentsOsRelevance: Reference for integrating Markdown semantics into Django model fields. Its current field implementation converts Markdown to HTML during field cleaning, so it is more useful as a comparison point and anti-pattern reference than as a direct dependency for Atlas or a Git-authoritative flat-file repository design.
